result.instructions: Tools for Sapo, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many orders came in this week and which ones are still unpaid?"; "Which products are running low on stock at my main branch?"; "Which customers were created since October 1, and how much has each spent?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Sapo data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run sapo_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run sapo_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run sapo_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. sapo_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.title: List inventory levels

available_min.description: Only levels with at least this much available.

available_max.description: Only levels with at most this much available.

starts_on_max.description: Only rules that start on or before this date.

tools.name: sapo_update_order
tools.title: Update order note or tags
tools.description: WRITE: set the note and/or the tags of an order (Sapo only lets an order's items and quantities stay fixed after creation). The value REPLACES the existing note or tags: read the order first to keep what is there. PUT /admin/orders/{id}.json.

note.description: New order note (replaces the old one; empty string clears it).

tags.description: New tag list (replaces all tags; an empty list clears them).

tools.name: sapo_set_inventory_level
tools.title: Set stock quantity
tools.description: WRITE: set the physical stock (on_hand) of one inventory item at one location to an exact quantity, with a reason. This OVERWRITES the current number and is recorded as a stock adjustment: read the level first (sapo_list_inventory_levels). PUT /admin/inventory_levels/set.json.

on_hand.description: Physical on-hand quantity to set (at most 3 decimals are kept).

reason.description: Why the stock changes (default: Sapo's own default).
